function: MIMO detection at the destination of an amplify-quantize-forward relay channel, using a deep-unfolded projected-gradient detector with learnable parameters. p. 2, 5
system: Half-duplex relay; source, relay, destination each with N antennas (N=1, 2, 4, 16); 4QAM/16QAM; no RIS; no frequency band stated. p. 2, 9, 10
method: Deep unfolding of projected gradient descent: P parallel networks of K layers with learnable parameters; supervised training on one-hot symbol labels, Adam, TensorFlow. p. 5, 8
data_channel: Own simulator: Rayleigh fading on all links; training samples generated on the fly from the system model; no standard channel model, dataset or measurement. p. 8, 9
test_conditions: Training: 50000 iterations of 1000 fresh samples, SNR not stated. Testing: BER over SNR for N=4 and 16, several channel-quality triples, same Rayleigh model. p. 8-10
baselines: Non-learned: ML, NML (own), ML for direct MIMO and AF relay. Learned: PDN [25] (direct MIMO), DL detector [10] (DF relay), same author. p. 9, 10
metrics: Bit error rate (BER) versus SNR. p. 9, 10
complexity: Learnable parameters KP[1+20(M+1)N^2+20(L+1)NR^2]; order O([KPM+ND]N^2+[KPL+ND]NR^2); ML and NML orders also given. p. 8, 9
openness: none. No code or data link; TensorFlow and Adam are only cited. p. 8
q1_support: p. 9: "Rayleigh fading channels are assumed in all the links". Custom simulator; no 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 8: "are generated according to their relationship in Section II in each iteration". Every setting (N, M, b, channel quality) uses data of the same model; no trained model is tested on another scenario, antenna number or modulation, and no adaptation is reported.
q3_support: p. 10: "denote the BERs of the ML detections in the MIMO system and the MIMO AF relay system" (non-learned); p. 10: "with the DL detection in [10] at the destination and the PDN detection with P = 8 [25]" (earlier learned detectors of the same author, BER compared).
q4_support: p. 8: "the total number of learnable parameters is KP" [1+20(M+1)N^2+20(L+1)NR^2]; p. 9: "complexity of the MIMO-DL detection method is approximately" O([KP M + ND]N^2 + [KP L + ND]NR^2).
q5_support: p. 8: "The training is implemented on the TensorFlow frameworks [29]". Only the framework is cited; data are simulated (p. 8-9), and no code or data link, public dataset or measured data appears in the paper.
notes: Include, area 1 (deep-unfolded detector MIMO-DL). The ML and NML detectors are the paper's own non-learned analytical detectors. For N=1 and 2 (Figs. 5-7) only ML and NML are compared, without learning. q3 is marked 1 because p. 10 and the footnote on p. 11 ("only the MIMO system and the DF relay system are used as the baseline for evaluation") use the author's earlier learned detectors [25] and [10] as BER baselines for N=16, but they are applied to the direct-link and DF relay systems and not to the AQF relay, so the reviewer should confirm this mark.
